description: How long a car takes right now between two national freeway (國道) interchanges, from live eTag gantry times: the fastest route, its distance and average speed, and the time and speed of each segment so slow stretches stand out. Example: from "林口", to "新竹".

from.description: Starting freeway interchange or junction, in Chinese as the freeway signs name it: 林口, 新竹, 臺中系統, 五股, 南港.

to.description: Destination freeway interchange or junction, in Chinese as the freeway signs name it: 林口, 新竹, 臺中系統, 五股, 南港.
